description: Unsigned transaction taking money out of the trade account: USDG (the default), a stock by its ticker or any token by its address, an amount or all: true. The owner can send it to any address (default the owner) at any time, whatever the account holds open; the agent can send it to the owner alone. Simulated from the wallet.

account.description: A trade account's address (default: the wallet's own, as its owner; an agent gives its owner's account)

all.description: Everything the account holds of it

amount.description: How much to take out, in whole units as a decimal string, like "1.5"

to.description: Where it goes (default the owner; the agent may send to the owner alone)

token.description: USDG (default), a stock's ticker, or a token's address

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

name: account_withdraw
title: Prepare: take money out of the trade account
